title: Engineers describe XF-131 Super Sentinel to Bill McDonald
summary: UAPGerb tells of Engineers describe XF-131 Super Sentinel to Bill McDonald, about 1992 at Mojave Desert, California, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In 1992, McDonald met with two Northrup and two Loheed engineers who were fed up with the secrecy and classification of their work who kind of dictated the a drawing of a triangular ARV called the XF-131 Super Sentinel

plain: An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says that in 1992 a man named Bill McDonald met four engineers in California's Mojave Desert, two from the aircraft maker Northrop and two from Lockheed, who were tired of the secrecy around their work. According to UAPGerb, they dictated to him a drawing of a triangular craft called the XF-131 Super Sentinel, which he calls an ARV, short for "alien reproduction vehicle", meaning a human-built copy of an alien craft. If true, it would suggest that US defense companies were building craft based on alien technology.
